articles.title: Swimming and the Meaning of Life
articles.highlight: 那种绝对临在与绝对宁静奇妙共存的感受，至今仍在我身体里回响。
articles.summary: 作者回忆了童年时在保加利亚山间河池中游泳的超越性体验，并将其与后来在氯气泳池中的竞技训练相对照，探讨游泳如何带来临在感与生命意义。文章以身体经验为切入点，引发对专注、自由与存在的深层思考，值得细读。
articles.failureAnalysis: 这篇非虚构随笔的关键启示在于：深刻的意义常源于全情投入当下的体验，而非量化的成绩或效率。
articles.sourceExcerpt: One of my earliest and most vivid childhood memories is of swimming in a cool pool bounded by boulders in the middle of a river in the mountains of Bulgaria, the late-afternoon sun casting komorebi on the water through the rustling leaves. I can still hear the feeling-tone in my body, the strange and lovely simultaneity of absolute presence and absolute peace. I didn’t yet know the word for transcendence.

articles.summary: 该研究提出一种双模块架构，用于实时脑电步态解码，以支持闭环下肢外骨骼控制。脑电信号受运动伪迹和低信噪比影响，限制了外骨骼应用。本文为初步研究，将在IEEE MLSP 2026上报告。
articles.failureAnalysis: 当前证据仅来自初步研究，且摘要信息不完整，缺少实验结果与性能对比。因此，该架构的实际解码精度和实时性尚待充分验证。
articles.sourceExcerpt: 2026 IEEE INTERNATIONAL WORKSHOP ON MACHINE LEARNING FOR SIGNAL PROCESSING, SEP. 1, 2026, ATLANTA, USA A 2-BLOCK ARCHITECTURE FOR REAL-TIME EEG GAIT DECODING: A PILOT STUDY Shantanu Sarkar1∗ Saurabh Prasad1 Jose Luis Contreras-Vidal1 1 IUCRC BRAIN Center, Cullen College of Engineering, University of Houston, Houston, TX, USA ∗ shantanu75@gmail.com ABSTRACT Closed-loop lower-limb exoskeleton control via Electroen- cephalography (EEG) remains limited by motion artifacts, low signal-to-noise ratio, and binary gait formulations that fail to capture full cortical gait complexity. We propose a 2-block Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) architecture: a trainable session-specific Feature Extraction Block with real- time artifact suppression and multi-domain feature extraction, coupled with a Decoder Block built on a novel Polynomial Time-Varying Layer (PolyTVL)+LSTM for four-state gait classification (Stand, Initiate, Execute, Terminate).

en.title: A 2-Block Architecture for Real-Time EEG Gait Decoding: A Pilot Study
en.highlight: Closed-loop lower-limb exoskeleton control via EEG remains limited by motion artifacts and low signal-to-noise ratio; a 2-block architecture is proposed for real-time EEG gait decoding.
en.summary: This study proposes a 2-block architecture for real-time EEG gait decoding to support closed-loop lower-limb exoskeleton control. EEG signals are currently limited by motion artifacts and low signal-to-noise ratio, restricting exoskeleton applications. This pilot study is to be reported at IEEE MLSP 2026.
en.failureAnalysis: The current evidence is limited to a pilot study, and the abstract is incomplete, lacking experimental results and performance comparisons. Therefore, the actual decoding accuracy and real-time capability of the architecture remain to be fully validated.

articles.title: alfredxw/denova
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 该仓库介绍了一个名为 denova 的 AI 创作平台，专注于小说写作和 AI 生成的 RPG 游戏。平台集成了 AI 代理、技能、子代理工作流、自动化、图像生成和版本控制等能力，试图为创作者提供一体化的创作环境。对于关注 AI 创作工具形态和创作者工作流自动化的人，值得研究其功能设计。
articles.failureAnalysis: 该平台可能面临用户需求分散的问题：小说创作和 AI RPG 是两种不同场景，功能叠加会提高使用复杂度。此外，AI 生成内容的质量和一致性难以保证，尤其是长篇叙事和角色扮演需要较强的上下文管理，当前技术成本高。项目仅有 602 星，缺乏生态和社区验证，商业化路径不清晰，可能在开源免费工具和大厂集成服务的夹缝中难以存活。

en.highlight: An AI creative platform for novel writing and AI-generated RPG, with built-in support for AI agents, Skills, subagent workflows, automations, image generation, and version control.
en.summary: This repository presents denova, an AI creative platform focused on novel writing and AI-generated RPGs. It integrates AI agents, skills, subagent workflows, automation, image generation, and version control to offer an all-in-one writing environment. It is worth reading for those interested in AI creative tools and workflow automation.
en.failureAnalysis: The project may suffer from scattered user needs: novel writing and AI RPG are different scenarios, and feature stacking increases complexity. Also, AI-generated content quality and consistency remain hard to guarantee, especially for long-form narratives, leading to high technical costs. With only 602 stars, weak ecosystem and unclear commercialization make it vulnerable between free tools and integrated big-tech offerings.
